open_points.text: identify_service: [SECURITY_BOUNDARY] MUST compare the UTF-8 bytes of presented_token through equal_in_constant_time with the bytes of every token give_service_tokens answers, asking for them at this call and keeping none, and answer an IdentifiedService of the service whose token is equal.
